'''Ansion''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] located in the [[Ansion system/Legends|Ansion system]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was orbited by six [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="TEA" />
